title: The Prisoner Exchange
text: A rider under a rival House's banner meets you on the road. That House found your Lost first, he says, and they are safe, more or less. They will be returned for a favor, to be named later. He smiles when he says later.

options.label: Accept their terms. Your Lost matter more than your pride.

outcomes.text: Your Lost come home. The favor will be called, and they will choose the hour.

options.label: The shrewdest bargains for gold instead, so no favor hangs over the House.

outcomes.text: Gold, not favors. The rider looks disappointed.

options.label: Refuse, and find your Lost yourselves. No House will hold this over you.

outcomes.text: The long way, and the honest one.
